dataset.name: Changhai resectable pancreatic-cancer cohort (GSE172356)
dataset.description: Independent cohort of resected primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas with public bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The Changhai Hospital study profiled 62 frozen, surgically resectable primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas. GEO links every GSM record to the source-local YX tumor identifier through Sample_description. The article supplement reports exact overall-survival time and status for 53 of those tumors; the other nine profiles are excluded before analysis because no individual endpoint is public.

metadata.source_program: Changhai Hospital resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Europe PMC
metadata.library_method: Paired-end whole-transcriptome sequencing of frozen primary pancreatic tumors; reads were aligned with HISAT2, summarized with HTSeq and normalized with DESeq2 size factors by the source study.
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival from tumor resection to death from any cause or last follow-up
metadata.endpoint_definition_note: The source workbook uses the legacy survival-analysis coding 1=censored and 2=death. This mapping was independently checked against all three published Figure 3 log-rank results: using 2 as the event reproduces p=0.037, 0.021 and 0.19, whereas the inverse coding does not.
metadata.sample_linkage_note: Each GEO sample has a source-local YX identifier in Sample_description. The same identifier names the public expression-matrix columns and the individual survival records, providing deterministic GSM-to-expression-to-endpoint linkage without positional matching.
metadata.sample_selection_note: All 62 GEO records are source-designated frozen primary pancreatic tumors and map one-to-one to patients. Fifty-three have exact positive overall-survival time and status; nine without public survival records are excluded.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The public matrix contains 45,140 unique gene-symbol rows and 62 DESeq2-normalized expression columns. TRACE Explorer selects the 53 endpoint-complete columns, excludes 2,382 genes with a source NA in any selected tumor, and applies log2(value + 1) to the remaining 42,758 complete rows; no imputation or duplicate-symbol aggregation is performed.
metadata.overlap_note: This Changhai Hospital resection cohort is independent of TCGA-PAAD and of the other PAAD cohorts in the repository.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the article's CC BY 4.0 license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: One source-designated frozen primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma per patient

expression.label: GEO DESeq2-normalized counts transformed to log2(value + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 45,140 source gene labels are unique both exactly and case-insensitively. The 2,382 rows with an NA in at least one selected tumor are excluded as complete rows rather than imputed.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer first retains endpoint-complete tumors, excludes any gene row with a source NA among those tumors, and then applies log2(value + 1) to the source-provided DESeq2-normalized values. Values support within-cohort analyses and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Overall survival from tumor resection
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause according to source status code 2; source status code 1 denotes censoring at last follow-up
